+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Shared resolver for the native and WASM Callisto setup actions.  This file
+# deliberately contains the closed product-release vocabulary; it never reads
+# a checkout manifest to decide what product or target to install.
+
+set -euo pipefail
+
+CALLISTO_REPOSITORY="orin-dx/callisto"
+CALLISTO_RELEASES_URL="https://github.com/${CALLISTO_REPOSITORY}/releases/download"
+CALLISTO_LATEST_API="https://api.github.com/repos/${CALLISTO_REPOSITORY}/releases/latest"
+
+callisto_error() {
+  printf '::error::setup-callisto: %s\n' "$*" >&2
+  return 1
+}
+
+callisto_parse_version() {
+  local requested="$1"
+  case "$requested" in
+    latest)
+      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="latest"
+      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION=""
+      ;;
+    callisto@*)
+      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="exact"
+      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION="${requested#callisto@}"
+      ;;
+    *)
+      CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND="exact"
+      CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION="$requested"
+      ;;
+  esac
+
+  if [[ "$CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND" == "exact" \
+    && ! "$CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    callisto_error "version '$requested' must be latest, X.Y.Z, or callisto@X.Y.Z"
+  fi
+}
+
+callisto_resolve_latest() {
+  local tag
+  if [[ -n "${CALLISTO_LATEST_TAG:-}" ]]; then
+    tag="$CALLISTO_LATEST_TAG"
+  else
+    tag="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location "$CALLISTO_LATEST_API" | jq -er '.tag_name')" \
+      || callisto_error "could not resolve latest Callisto product release"
+  fi
+
+  case "$tag" in
+    callisto@*) CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION="${tag#callisto@}" ;;
+    *) callisto_error "latest release tag '$tag' is not a callisto@X.Y.Z product release" ;;
+  esac
+  if ! [[ "$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
+    callisto_error "latest release tag '$tag' does not contain a semantic version"
+  fi
+}
+
+callisto_select_target() {
+  local artifact="$1"
+  if [[ "$artifact" == "wasm" ]]; then
+    CALLISTO_TARGET="wasm32-wasip1"
+    CALLISTO_ASSET_NAME="callisto-moon-wasm32-wasip1.wasm"
+    return 0
+  fi
+
+  local os_name arch_name
+  os_name="${CALLISTO_TEST_OS:-$(uname -s)}"
+  arch_name="${CALLISTO_TEST_ARCH:-$(uname -m)}"
+  case "${os_name,,}:${arch_name}" in
+    darwin:arm64|darwin:aarch64)
+      CALLISTO_TARGET="aarch64-apple-darwin"
+      ;;
+    linux:x86_64)
+      CALLISTO_TARGET="x86_64-unknown-linux-musl"
+      ;;
+    linux:arm64|linux:aarch64)
+      CALLISTO_TARGET="aarch64-unknown-linux-musl"
+      ;;
+    *)
+      callisto_error "unsupported host ${os_name}/${arch_name}; supported native targets are aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, and aarch64-unknown-linux-musl"
+      ;;
+  esac
+  CALLISTO_ASSET_NAME="callisto-${CALLISTO_TARGET}.tar.gz"
+}
+
+# Resolve one immutable product release before source selection or cache use.
+# Sets globals consumed by the composite actions and emits no network effects
+# for exact input versions.
+callisto_resolve() {
+  local source="$1" version="$2" artifact="$3"
+  case "$source" in auto|release|registry|local) ;; *)
+    callisto_error "source '$source' must be auto, release, registry, or local" ;;
+  esac
+  callisto_parse_version "$version"
+  if [[ "$source" == "local" && "$CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND" == "exact" ]]; then
+    callisto_error "source=local only accepts version=latest; it cannot build an exact released version"
+  fi
+
+  if [[ "$source" == "local" ]]; then
+    CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION="local"
+    CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG=""
+    CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION=""
+  elif [[ "$CALLISTO_REQUEST_KIND" == "latest" ]]; then
+    callisto_resolve_latest
+    CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG="callisto@${CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION}"
+    CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION="$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION"
+  else
+    CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION="$CALLISTO_REQUESTED_VERSION"
+    CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG="callisto@${CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION}"
+    CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION="$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION"
+  fi
+
+  CALLISTO_SOURCE="$source"
+  callisto_select_target "$artifact"
+  printf 'Resolved Callisto version: %s\n' "$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION"
+}
+
+callisto_write_outputs() {
+  : "${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?GITHUB_OUTPUT must be set before writing resolver outputs}"
+  {
+    printf 'resolved-version=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_RESOLVED_VERSION"
+    printf 'release-tag=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_RELEASE_TAG"
+    printf 'registry-version=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_REGISTRY_VERSION"
+    printf 'source=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_SOURCE"
+    printf 'target=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_TARGET"
+    printf 'asset-name=%s\n' "$CALLISTO_ASSET_NAME"
+  } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+}
+
+callisto_require_local_workspace() {
+  local workspace="$1"
+  [[ -f "$workspace/Cargo.toml" ]] \
+    && rg -q '^name = "callisto-cli"' "$workspace/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml" \
+    || callisto_error "source=local requires a Callisto workspace checkout"
+}
+
+callisto_install_native() {
+  local source="$1" version="$2" tag="$3" asset="$4" bin_dir="$5" workspace="$6"
+  mkdir -p "$bin_dir"
+  case "$source" in
+    local)
+      callisto_require_local_workspace "$workspace"
+      local commit built_version
+      commit="$(git -C "$workspace" rev-parse HEAD)" || callisto_error "source=local checkout has no readable commit"
+      cargo build --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-cli
+      cp "$workspace/target/debug/callisto" "$bin_dir/callisto"
+      built_version="$($bin_dir/callisto --version)" || callisto_error "locally built Callisto did not run"
+      printf 'Built Callisto from checkout commit %s: %s\n' "$commit" "$built_version"
+      ;;
+    registry)
+      cargo install callisto-cli --version "$version" --locked --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install" --quiet
+      cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto" "$bin_dir/callisto"
+      ;;
+    release|auto)
+      # S-003 supplies the fail-closed 404-only auto fallback classification.
+      curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
+        "${CALLISTO_RELEASES_URL}/${tag}/${asset}" \
+        --output "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${asset}"
+      tar -xzf "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${asset}" -C "$bin_dir"
+      ;;
+    *) callisto_error "internal error: unsupported source '$source'" ;;
+  esac
+}
+
+callisto_install_wasm() {
+  local source="$1" tag="$2" asset="$3" destination="$4" workspace="$5"
+  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$destination")"
+  case "$source" in
+    local)
+      callisto_require_local_workspace "$workspace"
+      cargo build --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-moon --target wasm32-wasip1 --features pdk --release
+      cp "$workspace/target/wasm32-wasip1/release/callisto_moon.wasm" "$destination"
+      ;;
+    release|auto)
+      curl --fail --silent --show-error --location \
+        "${CALLISTO_RELEASES_URL}/${tag}/${asset}" --output "$destination"
+      ;;
+    registry)
+      callisto_error "source=registry does not provide the callisto-moon WASM artifact"
+      ;;
+    *) callisto_error "internal error: unsupported source '$source'" ;;
+  esac
+}
*** End Patch";
